chore(xterm): site xterm.js 5.3 → @xterm/xterm 6, and the page's synchronized-output shim goes (rich-xterm-h736) (#349)

* chore(xterm): site xterm.js 5.3 → @xterm/xterm 6, and the page's synchronized-output shim goes (rich-xterm-h736)

xterm 6 buffers DEC mode 2026 itself, so `synchronized()` and its test are
deleted.

xterm 6 measures a character on an OffscreenCanvas, which ignores the
`.xterm-char-measure-element` line-height override, so rows came out 1–1.6px
taller than the page's line (the PR #330 revert). A `lineHeight` factor
cannot fix that: the canvas box of a reader's installed face can be taller
than 1.25em, and xterm refuses a factor under 1. `openMeasuringInPage` hides
OffscreenCanvas for the one `open()` call, so xterm picks its in-page DOM
measure and the override applies again, as it did on 5.3.

The dev-only BrowserTerminalHost harness page carries its own pin and is
bumped to match.

* review(xterm): the harness loads the site's xterm pin; comments name openMeasuringInPage and what stop leaves mid-frame (rich-xterm-h736)
